title: AC1027 HEADER suffix ODA CLI retry after user unlock
scope: One retry of the previously failing ODA File Converter 27.1.0 CLI invocation after the user reported unlocking the Mac; determine whether the process reaches document handling.

source.provenanceLimit: Existing local source copied to scratch; no DWG/DXF fixture was created or added to the repository.

converter.stderr:
PasteBoard: Error creating pasteboard: com.apple.pasteboard.clipboard [-4960]
PasteBoard: Error creating pasteboard: com.apple.pasteboard.find [-4960]
2026-11-08 02:46:09.473 ODAFileConverter[29884:1698660] Connection Invalid error for service com.apple.hiservices-xpcservice.
2026-11-08 02:46:09.473 ODAFileConverter[29884:1698658] Error received in message reply handler: Connection invalid

decision: The retry again aborts during Pasteboard/XPC initialization before document processing, despite the user-reported unlock. Mark this unchanged direct CLI invocation exhausted; do not retry it absent a concrete executable or launch-environment change. This says nothing about suffix semantics. Keep the suffix unclaimed and strict output refused at the independent source-reference gate.
